Source-assisted reading of Stams Frg. 174 (F-yslj), 1 November 2026. Reread on the image by a research reader: the whole notes panel on canvas 0 (piece 174-2r) and the German entry on canvas 1 (piece 174-1v); the five Robert lines and the dateline reread independently by a second research reader before opening a source; single words of the German entry reread from neutral crops by fresh readers. Regions are width x height at x,y in native pixels. ( ) expansion, [ ] lost or supplied, ? doubtful.
